scope: sections 6.3 chain gas and 6.5, explicitly fixed local Osaka EVM
primary_measurement: Anvil 1.5.1 actual transaction receipts; Geth v1.17.10 independent offline replay
counterfactual: Amsterdam rows are offline rule comparison only, not new Sepolia observations

certification.scope: Actual gas from one continuous trajectory; prefixes are not independent repeats; no protocol latency claim; no extrapolation above k=10. Local Osaka receipts; no public-chain finality claim.

trade.scope: formal local Osaka gas measurement; not a Sepolia observation
trade.verification: offline arithmetic audit of receipts; chain checks and decryption are performed by tradegasbench

limitations: This is a local Gas benchmark, not Sepolia timing or consensus-finality measurement.
Ten certifications form one continuous state trajectory, not ten independent trajectories.
Trade samples are contract microbenchmarks using independently verified task outputs and test receipt keys; no new SGX execution.
Two RPC connections reach the same local node; independent EVM validation is provided separately by Geth.
Refund Gas is measured after advancing local chain time beyond the deadline, not by measuring real-network waiting.
Prior Sepolia and pilot observations are preserved separately and excluded from formal means.
